title: Expectation reduced to relevant coordinates
statement: Let $E$ and $\Omega$ be finite sets, with $\Omega$ nonempty. Let $D\subseteq E$ and let $h:\Omega^E\to\mathbb{R}$ depend only on the coordinates in $D$. Then the uniform average of $h$ over assignments on $E$ equals its uniform average over assignments on $D$, extending each such assignment to $E$ by a fixed arbitrary element of $\Omega$ outside $D$.
hypotheses_covered: $h$ is a real-valued function on assignments $E\to\Omega$
